mapper.select: select m.id, m.title, m.content, m.status, m.progress, m.dead_line, m.priority, m.user_id from mes_rec_task m where m.deleted_flag = 0 and m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status not in ('completed', 'cancel', 'paused') and ( m.dead_line is null or m.dead_line >= #{todayStart} or m.dead_line < #{todayStart} ) order by m.dead_line asc, m.id asc

select m.id, m.title, m.content, m.status, m.progress, m.dead_line, m.priority, m.user_id from mes_rec_task m where m.deleted_flag = 0 and m.user_id = #{userId} order by m.create_time desc, m.id desc limit 1
